decision: Keep static-initializer dependency observation separate from target ordering and typed reuse
why: The collector can record which sealed typed facts a static field consumes without deciding target layout or skipping compiler work

decision: Add one implementation-sensitive edge alongside each ordinary resolved dependency consumed by a static field initializer
why: A provider body can change the value or ordering of program initialization even when its public signature stays the same
result: static calls, field reads, and nominal types retain exact initializer and provider identities

decision: Do not give instance field initializers the static-initialization dependency kind
why: Instance initialization happens when an object is constructed and must not be mislabeled as whole-program static initialization
result: instance consumer remains unaffected by provider body-only edit

decision: Accept the collector and invalidation behavior after three focused dependency tests passed
why: The slice must prove exact edges, implementation propagation, public report privacy, and deterministic A-to-B-to-A restoration before broader gates
evidence: npm run test:m14:compiler-dependency-observation; npm run test:m14:compiler-dependency-edit-sequence; npm run test:m14:compilation-server-dependency-observation

decision: Accept the shared typed-fact change across the complete compiler shard
why: The collector reads sealed typed expressions used by every backend, so the appropriate wider boundary is the compiler shard rather than one target suite

decision: Accept the source, architecture, provenance, runtime ownership, test-routing, and formatting contracts
why: The new edge kind crosses compiler reports and generated bootstrap code, so focused semantic tests must be backed by repository boundary checks
result: all guards passed; 886 Haxe files are formatted

decision: Keep typed-module reuse disabled and leave README Goals unchanged
why: This slice makes one missing dependency relationship observable but does not prove the complete zero-false-negative invalidation graph needed to skip typing
result: source, resolution, and parser reuse only; no readiness increase
